edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender key of balances in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of allowed in StandardToken.transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner key of allowed in StandardToken.approve.
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting privileged control.
NIGIZ constructor assigns the entire initial supply to balances[msg.sender].
The onlyOwner require compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
transfer credits the recipient through SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
transfer debits the sender through SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom debits balances[_from] via SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom credits balances[_to] via SafeMath.add.
transferFrom reduces the caller allowance via SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for both parties.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
mint increases totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
mint credits the recipient through SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
mint writes the totalSupply state variable.
mint writes the balances mapping for the recipient.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed allowance mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
onlyOwner modifier enforces the require(msg.sender == owner) access check.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable, changing privilege holders.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
finishMinting is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint is additionally guarded by the canMint modifier.
canMint reads mintingFinished to decide whether minting is still allowed.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true.
NIGIZ constructor writes totalSupply with the initial supply.
NIGIZ constructor writes balances[msg.sender] with the initial supply.
NIGIZ constructor updates the initialSupply state variable.
transfer param _to is used as recipient key for balances and Transfer event.
transfer param _value is consumed by SafeMath.sub/add on balances.
transfer _value is subtracted from the sender balance.
balanceOf param _owner is used as balances lookup key.
transferFrom param _from is used as source balance and allowance key.
transferFrom param _to is used as recipient balance key.
transferFrom param _value is consumed by SafeMath.add/sub operations.
approve param _spender is used as allowance key.
approve param _value is stored and checked against zero.
allowance param _owner is used as allowance lookup key.
allowance param _spender is used as allowance lookup key.
transferOwnership param newOwner becomes the new privileged owner address.
mint param _to is used as recipient balance key.
mint param _amount feeds SafeMath.add on totalSupply and balances.
SafeMath.mul operand a participates in unprotected multiplication.
SafeMath.mul operand b participates in unprotected multiplication.
SafeMath.div dividend a participates in division.
SafeMath.div divisor b participates in division.
SafeMath.sub minuend a participates in subtraction.
SafeMath.sub subtrahend b participates in subtraction.
SafeMath.add first addend participates in addition.
SafeMath.add second addend participates in addition.
SafeMath.mul stores the product in local variable c before the assert check.
SafeMath.div stores the quotient in local variable c.
transferFrom caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] into local var _allowance.
The cached _allowance is reduced by _value via SafeMath.sub.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a recipient key local to transfer and carries no independent semantic identity.
_value exists solely to drive the SafeMath.sub debit on the sender balance.
_owner is only the lookup key of a pure read function.
_from is only the source key used for balance and allowance updates within transferFrom.
_to is only the destination key used for the balance credit within transferFrom.
_value directly parameterises the arithmetic debit performed on balances[_from].
_spender is only the allowance mapping key inside approve.
_value is only the allowance amount stored by approve.
_owner is only an allowance lookup key in a view function.
_spender is only an allowance lookup key in a view function.
newOwner exists only to be written into the owner state variable by transferOwnership.
_to is only the recipient balance key inside mint.
_amount directly drives the SafeMath.add growth of totalSupply during mint.
a is an operand used only inside the multiplication helper.
b is an operand used only inside the multiplication helper.
a is an operand used only inside the division helper.
b is an operand used only inside the division helper.
a is an operand used only inside the subtraction helper.
b is an operand used only inside the subtraction helper.
a is an operand used only inside the addition helper.
b is an operand used only inside the addition helper.
c is a temporary product local to SafeMath.mul.
c is a temporary quotient local to SafeMath.div.
_allowance is a transient cache feeding the allowance arithmetic reduction.
